item.title: Full-Stack Software Developer & Consultant
item.description:
Overview:

Worked as a full-stack developer and consultant at Ramboll, contributing to large-scale risk analysis and safety platforms as well as greenfield enterprise application development.

Key contributions:

  • Backend development for large-scale risk analysis and safety platforms using Python/Django and PostgreSQL.
  • Refactored legacy systems, resolved circular dependencies, and improved overall system performance.
  • Built dashboards, migrated UI components to HTMX, and supported frontend modernization efforts.
  • Developed core components of a new .NET 7 DDD-based enterprise platform.
  • Mentored junior developers and maintained coding standards within a small team.

item.title: Lead Software Developer
item.description:
Overview:

Led the software development effort at QuadSAT, a company specializing in drone-based satellite antenna testing. Responsible for initiating and driving the development of the core desktop application and data analysis tooling.

Key contributions:

  • Initiated and led the development of the Python/Qt desktop application for aerial drone flight planning and execution.
  • Implemented a data ingestion, processing, and visualization application for RF-antenna performance analysis.
  • Integrated real-time hardware APIs and coordinated a small development team on the greenfield desktop application.
  • Contributed to European Space Agency (ESA) engineering projects.

item.title: Software Developer - Part Time
item.description:
Overview:

Part-time software developer at Novicell, one of Denmark’s leading digital agencies, working on the A-Team responsible for some of the country’s largest e-commerce platforms including Power.dk, Biltema.dk, and Apoteket.dk.

Key contributions:

  • Conducted a scientific feasibility study on RabbitMQ as a core messaging technology for high-throughput e-commerce platforms including Power.dk, Biltema.dk, and Apoteket.dk.
  • Designed and executed large-scale performance tests across single-node and multi-node RabbitMQ clusters, using Docker to automate deployments and ensure reproducible environments.
  • Identified a two-order-of-magnitude throughput bottleneck in the proposed production architecture, delivering findings directly to senior engineering leadership and informing revised system design.
  • Developed a dynamic, read-only C# monitoring framework for RabbitMQ, generating strongly typed models at runtime via reflection based on the server’s management API metadata.
  • Demonstrated advanced distributed-system debugging and architectural analysis skills, contributing widely referenced RabbitMQ insights on StackOverflow and briefly becoming the top-ranked contributor in the RabbitMQ tag.
  • Provided architectural guidance that helped prevent scalability issues during peak retail events and laid groundwork for future internal observability tooling.

item.title: Software Developer - Part Time
item.description:
Overview:

Developed a software platform for the Cognition and Behavior Laboratory at Aarhus University to investigate biometric synchronization during shared cognitive and vocal tasks.

Key contributions:

  • Designed and developed a software platform to investigate biometric synchronization during shared cognitive and vocal tasks.
  • Engineered real-time data synchronization across heterogeneous input streams, including heart rate sensors, Wii remotes, and audio recordings.
  • Implemented custom Wii remote integration, translating accelerometer data into precise on-screen cursor control.
  • Built a concurrent threading architecture to ensure low-latency, high-throughput data capture and alignment across all devices.
  • Integrated audio recording pipelines with minimal latency, enabling reliable multimodal data collection in a complex experimental environment.
  • Delivered an innovative technical foundation for future research despite project cancellation due to budget constraints.
